status: Experiment hypotheses for phase 1, frozen before child-03 evaluation. Not approved product settings; the earlier proposal's values are not inherited.
repository_presence: H1: keep a candidate only when every index token has file_count >= 1 in the published statistics. Phrases are judged by component presence only; no phrase or adjacency count exists.
commonness_rule: H2: drop a single-index-token candidate whose live-file fraction exceeds the value. Multi-token candidates have no defined fraction and are not filtered. The value is a hypothesis; per-candidate counts are saved so other cutoffs can be recomputed without rerunning.
final_limit_rule: H3: at most this many final terms per input after deduplication; every earlier-stage candidate stays in the output.
ordering: H4: relation-kind priority, then the query word's WordNet sense order (0 = most frequent; non-WordNet evidence = 0), then more supporting relations, then exact_key.
deduplication: Candidates with identical index-token sequences (for example 'publish-subscribe' and 'publish subscribe') collapse to the first in order.
not_ready_behavior: When repository statistics are not ready (stale, missing, incompatible, unavailable, not configured), no final terms are produced; dictionary candidates are still reported as not_evaluated.
